theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ δ₂ ε₂ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < δ₂ ∧ 0 < ε₂ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₂ → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ ε₂ → LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal ε) f → ∀ ζ ∈ q '' graphOver f univ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 2 * (δ * ρ) → 0 < infDist ζ V.support → infDist ζ V.support ≤ δ * ρ → ∃ y ∈ V.support, dist y ζ = infDist ζ V.support ∧ (infDist ζ V.support / 2) ^ n ≤ C₂ * ((V.weight (closedBall ζ (3 * (infDist ζ V.support / 2)) \ q '' graphOver f univ)).toReal + ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * (infDist ζ V.support / 2)), hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection) ∂V.weight)
